text:
Tara Nguyen: Heads-up  candidate Noor Ali is a single parent and needs the interview to finish by 6:15pm PT on Tue 2026-07-21 for school pickup. She asked if we can do a single 40-45min concentrated loop starting 5:30pm PT. Is that feasible?

Liam Brooks: I can move my 5pm slot. 5:3045 works for me. I can take the system design portion first 20-25m.

Zoe Kim: I have a 6:30pm sync so ending by 6:15 is perfect. I can do deep dive 5:55-6:10. Prefer remote.

Tara Nguyen: Plan: 17:30-18:15 PT condensed loop (45m)  Liam 5:30-5:55, Zoe 5:55-6:10, wrap 6:10-6:15. Recruiter will confirm with Noor and pre-approve any childcare voucher.

Ops Bot: Policy note: caregiver/childcare support available as either a one-time stipend (up to $100) or a childcare voucher depending on country. Pre-approval required. Submit receipts or voucher code request to Expensify with expense code "CARE-INTERVIEW" and tag "people-ops". Approval must be logged before reimbursement.

Recruiter - Hana: I'll confirm with Noor and ask whether she wants the stipend or a voucher. Also will offer Quiet Room F1 as an on-site fallback in case she can make it early.

Candidate - Noor: Thanks  5:30pm PT on Tue works. I prefer remote but really appreciate the childcare option. Stipend is fine. I also prefer no recording of the interview (privacy).

Tara Nguyen: Noted re recordings. Ops Bot, any note about recordings and candidate consent?

Ops Bot: Recording policy: interviews are not recorded by default. If an interviewer wants a recording for evaluation, they must get explicit candidate consent and log it to people-ops before the interview. Consent must be documented in the candidate record.

Liam Brooks: No recording needed. Can you add a 1-paragraph candidate prep note and a collaborative doc link? Also please include a backup Meet in the invite in case Zoom lags.

Recruiter - Hana: Adding prep note and two links. Calendar snippet I'll paste: ```
Zoom: https://zoom.us/j/222333444
Passcode: RedwoodHire
Backup Meet: https://meet.google.com/xyz-1234
Start: Tue 2026-07-21 17:30 PT (UTC-7)
Agenda: 17:30-17:55 system design (Liam), 17:55-18:10 deep dive (Zoe), 18:10-18:15 wrap + logistics
Candidate prep: We focus on a single system design prompt; please use shared Google Doc for whiteboarding. No recording unless candidate explicitly consents.```

Tara Nguyen: I'll pre-approve the $100 stipend and log it now. Hana please instruct Noor to upload receipt to Expensify after the interview and tag people-ops. I'll reserve Quiet Room F1 as backup and request a guest badge in case she comes onsite last-minute.

Recruiter - Hana: Done. Invite sent with both links, prep note, and stipend pre-approval message. DMing Noor with expense flow and privacy note.

Candidate - Noor: Received invite  thanks everyone. Appreciate the flexibility and the stipend. I'll join remote and upload receipt if I use care.

Zoe Kim: All set on my side. No special equipment needed.

Liam Brooks: Same. Thanks team  nice to keep this compact for Noor.

Tara Nguyen: Thanks all. I'll follow up after the loop with expense next steps and interviewer quick notes. :heart:
